info.title: Intutic Control Plane API
info.description: Generated from the control plane's route source. 412 operations; 98 validate their JSON body and 36 their query string with a schema, shown here. 33 read a body no schema validates. No route declares a response schema, so responses list status codes only. `x-intutic-request-schema` and `x-intutic-response-schema` say which operations have one.
